FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE MEMBER OF THE
WARAKAPOLA PRADESHIYA SABHA
UNDER SECTION 65A (2) OF THELOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE
(CHAPTER 262) AS AMENDED BYLOCAL AUTHORITIES (SPECIAL PROVISIONS) ACT, No. 30 OF 2013
WHEREAS, the office of a member in Warakapola Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason of Death ;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the recognized political party namely United People's Freedom Alliance, towhich the Former member R.A. Kapila Senevirathne belonged was required by me under Section 65A(2) of the aforesaidOrdinance, to nominate within a period of thirty (30) days a person eligible under the Ordinance for Election as a member ofthat Warakapola Pradeshiya Sabha who shall be declared elected as a member ;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party has nominated Mr. UdahawiyannalageSanjaya Sanevirathna being an eligible person under the aforesaid Ordinance to fill such vacancy :

NOW THEREFORE I, Gamalathge Dilip Nishantha, Returning Officer of Warakapola Pradeshiya Sabha, acting interms of Section 65A(2) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance as amended by filling of vacancies in Local Authorities(Special Provisions) Act, No. 30 of 2013 (Chapter 262) do hereby declare Mr. Udahawiyannalage Sanjaya Sanevirathnaelected as a member of the Warakapola Pradeshiya Sabha.
GAMALATHGE DILIP NISHANTHA,
Returning Officer,Warakapola Pradeshiya Sabha.
District Elections Office,Kegalle,14th May 2015.
